question_text: What is the supreme law of the land?
disambiguation: Don't mix these up: the “supreme law of the land” is the Constitution itself — not the “Supreme Court.” One is the rulebook; the other is the referee.

why_it_matters.text: Even the President has to obey the Constitution. That's the big idea: no one in America is above the law — not even the most powerful person. The law itself is the boss.

fun_fact.text: Long ago, Maryland tried to tax a national bank to death. The Supreme Court said no — one state can't destroy what the whole country builds. That's how we learned: when state and national law collide, national law wins.
